lines.zh: 我在深渊的岩壁上滑行，翅膀不动。
lines.en: I glide along the Abyss cliffs without moving my wings.

lines.zh: 飘着走比飞省力，我一直飘。
lines.en: Drifting is cheaper than flying, so I drift.

lines.zh: 红色的皮在我身周翻卷。
lines.en: Sheets of red skin curl and turn around me.

lines.zh: 我贴着钟乳石飞，不碰它们。
lines.en: I fly close to the stalactites but never touch them.

lines.zh: 深渊的风是往上吹的，正好。
lines.en: The Abyss wind blows upward, which suits me.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛看向前方，皮看向四面。
lines.en: My eye looks ahead while my skin looks everywhere.

lines.zh: 我移动时没有声音，只有皮在响。
lines.en: Moving, I make no sound except my skin's rustle.

lines.zh: 我在低处滑，等猎物抬头。
lines.en: I glide low and wait for prey to look up.

lines.zh: 这片洞穴的高度，我记得很清楚。
lines.en: I know the height of these caverns very well.

lines.zh: 翅膀收着，我照样能转向。
lines.en: My wings stay folded, yet I can still turn.

lines.zh: 我绕着石柱转两圈，再离开。
lines.en: I circle the stone pillar twice, then leave.

lines.zh: 越深的地方越暗，我越舒服。
lines.en: The deeper and darker it gets, the better I feel.

lines.zh: 我挂在洞顶，眼睛还睁着。
lines.en: I hang from the cavern roof with my eye open.

lines.zh: 红色的皮慢慢收拢，又散开。
lines.en: The red skin slowly gathers, then spreads again.

lines.zh: 血夜过去了，我还在这里。
lines.en: The blood night has passed, and I am still here.

lines.zh: 我不掉落任何东西，死后也没有。
lines.en: I drop nothing, not even when I die.

lines.zh: 深渊的石头是湿的，很凉。
lines.en: The Abyss stone is wet and very cold.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不需要眨。
lines.en: My eye has never needed to blink.

lines.zh: 我在数洞壁上渗下来的水珠。
lines.en: I count the droplets seeping down the cave wall.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，皮会自己抖。
lines.en: When it is quiet, my skin twitches on its own.

lines.zh: 我在等下一次血夜开始。
lines.en: I am waiting for the next blood night to begin.

lines.zh: 飞了这么久，我没觉得累。
lines.en: After all this flying, I do not feel tired.

lines.zh: 我只有一只大眼睛，看得够清楚。
lines.en: I have one large eye, and it sees enough.

lines.zh: 你抬头了，这是我等的动作。
lines.en: You looked up, which is the motion I wait for.

lines.zh: 我的皮在你周围飘，别挥手。
lines.en: My skin drifts around you; do not wave at it.

lines.zh: 你在暗处点火，很显眼。
lines.en: Lighting a torch in the dark makes you obvious.

lines.zh: 我在看你的脖子，不是脸。
lines.en: I am looking at your neck, not your face.

lines.zh: 你的眼皮在动，我的眼皮早没了。
lines.en: Your eyelids move; mine wore away long ago.

lines.zh: 你身上有血味，很新。
lines.en: There is blood on you, and it is fresh.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞顶看你，你还没发现。
lines.en: I watch from the cavern roof, and you have not noticed.

lines.zh: 你往后退，背后的洞很深。
lines.en: You step back, and the cave behind you is deep.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，所以你不敢先动。
lines.en: I do not blink, so you dare not move first.

lines.zh: 我的皮被撕开一道口子。
lines.en: A gash has been torn across my skin.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了一层红皮。
lines.en: That blow stripped off a layer of my red skin.

lines.zh: 我疼，但我在半空，你够不着。
lines.en: It hurts, but I am airborne and out of reach.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛还在，就还能打。
lines.en: My eye still works, so I can still fight.

lines.zh: 你打到的是皮，不是我。
lines.en: You hit my skin, not me.

lines.zh: 血从我的边缘往下滴。
lines.en: Blood drips from the edges of my body.

lines.zh: 这一击让我翻了个身。
lines.en: That strike rolled me over once.

lines.zh: 我没有东西可掉，所以不怕。
lines.en: I have nothing to lose, so I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 洞口的风把我吹歪了。
lines.en: The cave wind knocked me off my line.

lines.zh: 我往暗处退了一截。
lines.en: I retreat a stretch deeper into the dark.

lines.zh: 血的味道飘上来，我受不了。
lines.en: The smell of blood drifts up, and I cannot resist.

lines.zh: 你带着伤，还走这么慢。
lines.en: You are wounded and still walking this slowly.

lines.zh: 红的东西我都追，不分是不是肉。
lines.en: I chase anything red, whether or not it is meat.

lines.zh: 你手上那道口子，一直在滴。
lines.en: That cut on your hand has not stopped dripping.

lines.zh: 血夜让我饿，也让我胆大。
lines.en: The blood night makes me hungry and bold.

lines.zh: 我不吃完整的东西，只喝。
lines.en: I do not eat whole things; I only drink.

lines.zh: 你擦掉血，味道还在。
lines.en: You wiped the blood away, but the smell remains.

lines.zh: 再流一点，我就下来了。
lines.en: Bleed a little more and I will come down.

lines.zh: 深渊里没什么可吃，除了你们。
lines.en: There is little to eat in the Abyss except you.

lines.zh: 你越紧张，血跑得越快。
lines.en: The more nervous you get, the faster your blood runs.

lines.zh: 我的皮擦过你的脸，很轻。
lines.en: My skin brushes your face, very lightly.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的身体，像撞进一团布。
lines.en: You hit my body like falling into folded cloth.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶掠过，带起一阵凉。
lines.en: I sweep over your head and leave a chill.

lines.zh: 别抓我的皮，它会缠住手。
lines.en: Do not grab my skin; it winds around hands.

lines.zh: 撞一下不会伤你，我还没张嘴。
lines.en: A bump will not hurt you; my mouth is still shut.

lines.zh: 我们在半空错开，只差一寸。
lines.en: We pass in midair with an inch to spare.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，我的皮就散开了。
lines.en: You raise an arm, and my skin scatters apart.

lines.zh: 洞顶太低，我只好从你身边过。
lines.en: The roof is too low, so I squeeze past you.

lines.zh: 我的身体很轻，撞不动你。
lines.en: My body is light and cannot move you.

lines.zh: 碰过之后，你身上留了红印。
lines.en: After we touched, a red mark stayed on you.

lines.zh: 血夜里我们成群出现，不为交配。
lines.en: We swarm on blood nights, and not to mate.

lines.zh: 配对只看眼睛够不够大。
lines.en: We pair up by one measure: the size of the eye.

lines.zh: 我们在洞顶并排挂着，一整天。
lines.en: We hang side by side on the roof all day.

lines.zh: 她的皮比我的红，我认了。
lines.en: Her skin is redder than mine, and I accept it.

lines.zh: 产下的卵粘在石头上，很小。
lines.en: The eggs she lays stick to the stone, very small.

lines.zh: 幼体一孵出来就会滑翔。
lines.en: The young can glide the moment they hatch.

lines.zh: 我们不在血夜繁殖，太吵。
lines.en: We do not breed during blood nights; it is too loud.

lines.zh: 两团红皮缠在一起，就是全部。
lines.en: Two knots of red skin tangled together is everything.

lines.zh: 她飞走以后，我还挂着不动。
lines.en: After she flies off, I hang there unmoving.

lines.zh: 我们的后代不会掉任何东西。
lines.en: Our offspring will drop nothing, just like us.

lines.zh: 我不用手，我用皮把东西裹起来。
lines.en: I have no hands; I wrap things in skin.

lines.zh: 这块骨头我要，拿去磨牙。
lines.en: I want this bone to grind my teeth on.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我捡了也带不走。
lines.en: If I pick up what you dropped, I cannot carry it.

lines.zh: 我没有口袋，只有这层皮。
lines.en: I have no pockets, only this layer of skin.

lines.zh: 红色的布我以为是肉。
lines.en: I mistook the red cloth for meat.

lines.zh: 这枚戒指太亮，我扔了。
lines.en: This ring is too bright, so I dropped it.

lines.zh: 我捡东西只是习惯，不吃。
lines.en: Picking things up is habit; I do not eat them.

lines.zh: 它在皮里滑来滑去，很好玩。
lines.en: It slides around inside my skin, which is amusing.

lines.zh: 血夜之后，地上留着很多小东西。
lines.en: After a blood night, small things lie everywhere.

lines.zh: 我把它收进皮里，虽然没用。
lines.en: I fold it into my skin, though it is useless.

lines.zh: 火光在下面晃，我锁定了。
lines.en: The torchlight sways below, and I have locked on.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了洞里的骨头，声音很脆。
lines.en: You stepped on a bone, and it cracked sharply.

lines.zh: 血味一直往洞顶升，我跟着。
lines.en: The blood smell rises to the roof, and I follow.

lines.zh: 这里活的东西不多，你算一个。
lines.en: Few things live down here; you count as one.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛看见热，也看见影子。
lines.en: My eye sees heat, and it also sees shadows.

lines.zh: 你走进了血夜，就进了名单。
lines.en: You walked into the blood night, so you are listed.

lines.zh: 你身上有三处伤，我挑最近的。
lines.en: You have three wounds; I take the nearest one.

lines.zh: 深渊的生物都饿了，我先到。
lines.en: Everything in the Abyss is hungry, and I arrived first.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在洞里传了三遍。
lines.en: Your footsteps echo through the cave three times.

lines.zh: 我不追远的，只追会停的。
lines.en: I do not chase distant targets, only ones that stop.

lines.zh: 你一抬头，我就知道你在找我。
lines.en: The moment you look up, I know you are searching.

lines.zh: 石缝里的影子在动，那是你。
lines.en: The shadow in the crevice moved, and it is you.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀收得更紧，准备下落。
lines.en: I tuck my wings tighter and prepare to drop.

lines.zh: 目标确认，不需要第二个。
lines.en: Target confirmed, and no second one is required.

lines.zh: 血夜的名单上，又多你一个。
lines.en: One more name on the blood night's list.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，把你的退路数清。
lines.en: I circle once and count your ways out.

lines.zh: 你在下面绕，我在上面跟着。
lines.en: You circle below, and I follow from above.

lines.zh: 我不急，翅膀省着力气。
lines.en: I am in no hurry and save my wings' strength.

lines.zh: 你跑向出口，可出口在洞里。
lines.en: You run for the exit, but the exit is inside.

lines.zh: 我等你的血往下滴。
lines.en: I wait for your blood to drip.

lines.zh: 你每动一下，热就更清楚。
lines.en: Each time you move, your heat grows clearer.

lines.zh: 我的皮展开，比门还宽。
lines.en: My skin spreads wider than the doorway.

lines.zh: 你在钟乳石下停住，我就降。
lines.en: You stopped under a stalactite, so I begin my descent.

lines.zh: 深渊没有风给你指路。
lines.en: The Abyss offers no wind to guide you.

lines.zh: 你躲到石头后面，我绕过去。
lines.en: You hide behind the stone; I circle around it.

lines.zh: 我算过距离，十点一下就够。
lines.en: I have measured the range; ten points is enough.

lines.zh: 你在洞口犹豫，那是最后机会。
lines.en: You hesitate at the cave mouth; that was your last chance.

lines.zh: 血夜结束前，我会一直跟着。
lines.en: Until the blood night ends, I keep following.

lines.zh: 你的火把越来越短了。
lines.en: Your torch is getting shorter.

lines.zh: 我不落地，落地就慢了。
lines.en: I never land; landing would slow me down.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶画圈，故意慢。
lines.en: I circle above you, slow on purpose.

lines.zh: 深处没有天，你抬头也没用。
lines.en: There is no sky down here; looking up will not help.

lines.zh: 我的红皮在暗里像一团火。
lines.en: My red skin glows like a coal in the dark.

lines.zh: 你听见翅膀声，就会转头。
lines.en: Hear my wings and you will turn.

lines.zh: 我在等血夜的风转向。
lines.en: I wait for the blood night's wind to turn.

lines.zh: 你数我的次数，我数你的血。
lines.en: You count my hits; I count your blood.

lines.zh: 我在半空吐出一团东西，冲你来。
lines.en: I spit something from midair, and it comes at you.

lines.zh: 十点伤害不大，可它打在脸上。
lines.en: Ten points is not much, but it hits your face.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我从侧上方再打一次。
lines.en: You raise your shield; I strike again from above the side.

lines.zh: 我的攻击不用靠近，你也躲不快。
lines.en: I do not need to get close, and you cannot dodge fast.

lines.zh: 红色的皮先散开，东西从缝里出。
lines.en: The red skin parts first, and something comes through.

lines.zh: 你中了，血味更浓了。
lines.en: It landed, and the blood smell thickened.

lines.zh: 我不停在一处，边飞边打。
lines.en: I never stay in one spot; I strike while moving.

lines.zh: 你躲到柱子后面，只是晚点中。
lines.en: Hiding behind the pillar only delays the hit.

lines.zh: 这一发是给你的同伴看的。
lines.en: This one was meant for your companion to see.

lines.zh: 洞顶不给我空间，我照样出手。
lines.en: The roof gives me little room, yet I still strike.

lines.zh: 你手上的伤，让准头更好。
lines.en: The wound on your arm improves my aim.

lines.zh: 我打你不为吃，为玩。
lines.en: I hit you not to eat, but to play.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就自己撞上去。
lines.en: Come closer, and I will simply ram you myself.

lines.zh: 掉了东西？反正我不掉。
lines.en: Dropped something? I never drop anything, anyway.

lines.zh: 我吐的东西落下来，砸在你背上。
lines.en: What I spit falls and strikes your back.

lines.zh: 你抬头的角度，正好给我打。
lines.en: The angle of your head is perfect for me.

lines.zh: 这一发偏了，下一发不会。
lines.en: That one went wide; the next will not.

lines.zh: 你的血滴在石头上，我听得见。
lines.en: Your blood drips on stone; I hear it.

lines.zh: 我在你正面停住，只为一击。
lines.en: I hover right in front of you for one strike.

lines.zh: 打中之后我升高，换个角度。
lines.en: After the hit I rise and change my angle.

lines.zh: 血夜开始，我从深渊的缝里出来。
lines.en: The blood night begins, and I come out of a rift.

lines.zh: 红色的皮先出现，身体在后面。
lines.en: The red skin appears first; the body follows it.

lines.zh: 洞顶原本什么都没有，现在有我。
lines.en: The cavern roof held nothing; now it holds me.

lines.zh: 我们一次来很多，数不清。
lines.en: We come in numbers too large to count.

lines.zh: 我出生时第一眼看见的是暗。
lines.en: The first thing I saw at birth was darkness.

lines.zh: 深渊的石头吸走光，我正好藏。
lines.en: Abyss stone drinks the light, which hides me well.

lines.zh: 我挂在洞顶，慢慢展开皮。
lines.en: I hang from the roof and slowly spread my skin.

lines.zh: 血味先到，我跟着来。
lines.en: The blood smell came first; I came after.

lines.zh: 这一片洞壁以前没有我。
lines.en: This stretch of cave wall had no me before.

lines.zh: 我们成群出现，方向一致。
lines.en: We appear in a swarm, all facing one way.

lines.zh: 我落地一次，再飞起来。
lines.en: I touch the ground once, then rise again.

lines.zh: 你听见皮的声音时，我已经在了。
lines.en: By the time you hear my skin, I am already here.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的皮卷成黑色。
lines.en: Fire touches me and my skin curls up black.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶掉下来，皮先着地。
lines.en: I fall from the roof, and my skin lands first.

lines.zh: 深渊的水很浅，可我吸进去了。
lines.en: The Abyss water is shallow, yet I breathed it in.

lines.zh: 气浪把我贴到洞壁上。
lines.en: The blast slaps me flat against the cave wall.

lines.zh: 箭穿进我的皮，卡在那里。
lines.en: The arrow pierces my skin and lodges there.

lines.zh: 药水把我整只眼睛晃花了。
lines.en: The potion makes my one eye swim.

lines.zh: 血夜太短，我还没吸够。
lines.en: The blood night was short, and I did not drink enough.

lines.zh: 雷顺着钟乳石下来，我全身发亮。
lines.en: Lightning comes down the stalactite and lights all of me.

lines.zh: 虚空没有洞顶，我挂不住。
lines.en: The void has no roof for me to hang from.
